`v0.15.0` brings Omarchy 4.5 to new and existing installs, and stops Update > Omarchy from removing the camera and battery indicator.

# Features

* Omarchy 4.5.0 (Quattro RS), with its translations, workspace layouts, Omasnap screenshots and Disktree. Existing installs get it with their next Update > Omarchy (#393)
* With CPU rendering, Appearance > Animations now turns animations back on and off, and the choice lasts across restarts (#398)
* The setup window says when it is saving the new disk and registering with Windows, and the log records how long each setup step took (#397)

# Fixes

* Fix Update > Omarchy removing the camera and the battery indicator after the next restart. Installs that already lost them get them back on their first start with this release (#401)
* Fix text copied in Windows pasting as nothing in Omarchy when it looks like a PowerShell prompt (#398, #396)
* Omarchy uses less CPU while idle, because the audio bridge no longer checks PipeWire four times a second (#398)
* Fix Vulkan windows drawing skewed on Intel graphics unless the window width was a multiple of 64 pixels (#395, #394). Known issue: those windows can show red and blue swapped (#400); the Windows user environment variable `TRYOMARCHY_PITCH_COPY=off` goes back to the v0.14.0 behavior
* A first start while the PC's displays are off or Windows is locked no longer ends at the blank-window prompt (#397)
* Updated installs now get the same icon font, font rules, user services and fastfetch layout as new ones (#393)
* Catch-up no longer stops on early preview installs without DKMS (#393)

## Dev

* Build runtime r27 with the Venus row pitch fix (#395)
* Refresh the guest package lock, which brings in kernel 7.2.15, Hyprland 0.57.2, Omarchy's quickshell build and mise 2026.10.25 (#393, #398, #401, #403)
* The upgrade smoke test now fails when the kernel headers leave the kernel or the camera and battery modules are missing after an update (#401)
* A stopped guest build no longer deletes the host's device nodes (#393)
